artifact: Peer Host session messages (WP-2.3): the presentation, hello and challenge carried as PeerChannel frames, the transcript each proof signs as a COSE_Sign1 permguard.host.proof.v1 of the profile in crates/permguard-objects/src/cose.rs, and a verifier's seen epoch of a peer
authority: 1-architecture/2-architecture-server-host-identity.md#proof-of-possession (members), 6-contracts/8-contract-host-api.md#transport-binding, owner decisions of 2026-10-08 (labels, types, cardinalities, the signer role, hello's operation); crates/permguard-host/src/session/record.rs and peers.rs
encoding: deterministic CBOR (RFC 8949 core deterministic), integers in the signed 64-bit range

fields.name: document
fields.note: the sender's identity document, a COSE_Sign1 of identity.json's identity_document

fields.name: successions
fields.note: every succession record in order, each a COSE_Sign1 of identity.json's succession_record; at most 1024

fields.name: first_public_key
fields.note: the epoch-1 public key, the suite's raw encoding; its fingerprint is what a pin names

fields.name: host
fields.note: the initiator's host_id, 16 bytes, a UUIDv7

fields.name: epoch
fields.note: the initiator's identity epoch, from 1; the one its presentation verifies at

fields.name: declared_assurance
fields.note: development, production or regulated: a declaration for compatibility and audit, never attestation

fields.name: nonce
fields.note: nonce_A, exactly 16 bytes from the OS CSPRNG

fields.name: operation
fields.note: a closed registry: enroll, task or membership

fields.name: membership_id
fields.note: 1 to 128 bytes; absent is omitted, never null

fields.name: task
fields.note: 1 to 128 bytes; absent is omitted, never null

fields.name: request_digest
fields.note: the digest of the one request the session carries, under `permguard.membership.request.v1\n`: present exactly for enroll and membership (WP-4.1)

fields.name: host
fields.note: the responder's host_id, 16 bytes, a UUIDv7

fields.name: epoch
fields.note: the responder's identity epoch, from 1

fields.name: declared_assurance
fields.note: development, production or regulated

fields.name: nonce
fields.note: nonce_B, exactly 16 bytes from the OS CSPRNG, single-use on its channel

fields.name: expires
fields.note: seconds since the epoch, UTC: issue time plus 60; no proof is accepted after it

fields.name: protocol
fields.note: permguard.host.session.v1

fields.name: initiator_host
fields.note: 16 bytes

fields.name: responder_host
fields.note: 16 bytes

fields.name: initiator_epoch
fields.note: from the hello

fields.name: responder_epoch
fields.note: from the challenge

fields.name: nonce_a
fields.note: 16 bytes, the hello's nonce

fields.name: nonce_b
fields.note: 16 bytes, the challenge's nonce

fields.name: membership_id
fields.note: the hello's, omitted when it has none

fields.name: task
fields.note: the hello's, omitted when it has none

fields.name: operation
fields.note: the hello's operation

fields.name: expires_at
fields.note: the challenge's expires

fields.name: tls_exporter
fields.note: 32 bytes, TLS-Exporter("EXPORTER-Channel-Binding", "", 32) of the signer's own TLS 1.3 connection (RFC 9266); never carried by any frame

fields.name: hello_digest
fields.note: sha256 over the domain permguard.host.session.hello.v1 and a newline, then the hello's exact bytes

fields.name: challenge_digest
fields.note: sha256 over the domain permguard.host.session.challenge.v1 and a newline, then the challenge's exact bytes

fields.name: signer
fields.note: initiator or responder: the role of the Host whose proof signs it; the two proofs differ in this member alone

fields.name: request_digest
fields.note: the hello's, omitted when it has none: the proofs sign the request the session serves

fields.name: host_id
fields.note: the peer's host_id, 16 bytes; the file is host/peers/<host_id>.cbor

fields.name: epoch
fields.note: the highest epoch a session with the peer was established at

fields.name: fingerprint
fields.note: sha256:<hex> of the peer's key at that epoch

fields.name: at
fields.note: seconds since the epoch, UTC
